evidence.quote: if you visited any of the 178 affected organizations (188 snippets, including ledger, gitlab, zoom, salesforce, bbc, and hsbc...) over the last 24 hours, here is the technical breakdown and what you need to check.

1）treat your host screen as untrusted. when js primitives and network calls are hooked in the browser runtime, the address rendered on your monitor is already spoofed. verify the full recipient address on your hardware wallet's independent screen before signing.
2）clear your browser disk cache immediately. optimizely cdn assets are cached locally, meaning the poisoned <projectid>.js file can still execute on repeat visits even after upstream cleanup.
3）explicitly log out and log back into affected platforms to rotate server-side session tokens, in case your cookies lacked HttpOnly and got exfiltrated.

evidence.quote: Two paths went around it. Under the one-cent cap, a $1 swap into EURC and a $1 bridge to Circle's Arc chain both went through as if the cap weren't there, and both worked again on a second run. The transfer limit counts transfers. Swaps and bridges are contract calls, so the spending counter never moved. By design, an approval that lets an outside address
spend 1 USDC from the wallet went through too: Circle's docs say allowances aren't counted, and once approved, that address can move the funds without the wallet sending anything.

The fix already exists. With a contract allowlist set next to the limit, the swap and the bridge were both blocked: "Contract address is not on the allowlist". But Circle's guide presents the allowlist and the transfer limit as two options to choose from, and an owner who wants to cap spending reaches for the one called a limit.

evidence.quote: 聊完了高杠杆走钢索的 CoreWeave，和手握大把土地却疯狂发新股的 IREN，三部曲的最后压轴，聊聊我个人最看好的 Nebius ($NBIS)。

在动辄背几百亿高息债、或者疯狂增发稀释股东的 AI 算力圈里，Nebius 的财务健康度简直是一股清流： • 账上躺着 74 亿美元现金，有息负债只有 140 亿左右，净资产超过 120 亿美元，完全没有 CoreWeave 那种利息吃光利润的窒息感。• 更夸张的是它的商业模式：Q3 新签的合同里，超过 90% 都带客户预付款，而且客户提前交的定金，已经能覆盖 100% 以上的建设成本。相当于客户先掏钱、Nebius 拿客户的钱去买卡建机房，回本周期压缩到了短短 19 个月，根本不需要像 IREN 那样天天靠发新股抽老股东的血。
跌这么惨，不是因为没订单（Q3 营收暴增 571%，年末在手订单逼近 400 亿美元），纯粹是因为交付延期（Build-out delay）。新泽西州一个合作机房的第三方供电方提前撤出，导致原本年底要交付给微软的部分算力推迟了两个月，顺带着明年高达 400 多亿美元的资本开支计划也让市场短线犯了嘀咕。

items.new_information: 新增单token串行推理的初步测量及与GPT-6 Astra的比较，并指出潜在监控困难

evidence.quote: We also evaluated how many serial reasoning steps GPT-6.2 Astra can do in a single output token (without chain of thought). It can perform 12.3 steps, versus 10.5 for GPT-6 Astra and 8.6 for GPT-6.1 Sol, the previous highs. We measure the number of steps models can perform at an accuracy of 25% above chance, where each step is normalized for complexity.
This capability is notable because models that can do complex reasoning without any chain of thought may be harder to monitor.
We hope to finalize this and other measurements of more abstract model capabilities, and release them in the coming weeks.
